Release 2.9.1 completed. All 4 requirements implemented and verified:

[R1] CLI stabilization: pysemver without arguments raises SystemExit(2) instead of AttributeError; pysemver bump shows help text and exits gracefully.

[R2] Regex updated to semver.org spec: rejects zero-prefixed components (01.2.3, 1.02.3, 1.2.03), uses [1-9][0-9]* patterns for major/minor/patch.

[R3] Validation features: VersionInfo.isvalid() static method added; 'check' subcommand added to CLI.

[R4] Public API: cmd_bump, cmd_check, cmd_compare exposed as callable functions; createparser, finalize_version, process continue working correctly.

All 166 existing tests pass. STATUS.json written with all requirements at probability 1.0.
